query: In our previous molecular dynamics (MD) study (Hwang et al., 2020), instead of enforcing dissociation of the complex with high force, as done in steered MD simulations (Sibener et al., 2018; Wu et al., 2019), we applied pN-level forces and examined the behavior of the JM22 TCR complexed with an HLA-A*02:01 molecule presenting a peptide from an influenza virus matrix protein.
